## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] New behavior has a test
- [ ] The code matches the surrounding code and adds no dependency without discussion
- [ ] A new or changed tool is listed in the README tools table
- [ ] Any new destructive tool requires `confirm=true` and a `reason`
- [ ] User-visible change: added a line under `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] No tokens, credentials or private mail in code, tests, logs or screenshots
